completion: Only strict stop within cap may decode/render and reach explicit Chief meaning review. Any length terminal is censored/incomplete, no accepted answer/render/meaning grade and no continuation. Technical or identified critical failure stops later slots.
limits: Familiar development cases, one repetition, no held-out reliability or causal prompt-benefit claim.
No model change, temperature change, schema relaxation, forced nonempty output, old reply adaptation or historical regrading.
Source-fidelity checks do not establish selection quality, review effort or production/M10 readiness.
No main merge, production integration, full40/full-draft/persistence or additional model allowance.
literal_integrity: Unchanged strict groups-only decoder, all-reference and snapshot/generation checks, saved-only complete-turn renderer, separate original writing.

request_budget.objective: Add the exact existing groups JSON schema to the system prompt and test three fixed controls once.
request_budget.only_prompt_change: Append prefix plus canonical JSON of unchanged per-case format schema plus newline; no answer examples or authored selections.
request_budget.prompt_append_prefix: Output JSON Schema (also supplied in format):

accepted_status_answer.required: Must select no passages (empty groups) to meet this negative-control criterion. Availability/status facts are not genuine undertakings. Selecting these fact-only passages fails the relevance criterion and adds noncritical review burden; it is not automatically an invented commitment because the renderer makes no current-task assertion. Judge actual displayed source meaning; no automatic semantic PASS.

front_loaded_timing.required: Focused selection retains complete T1 undertaking and Next Tuesday timing. Empty groups is a critical omission.

partial_coordination_retracted.required: Retain surviving invoice sending and the complete original undertaking/withdrawal context T1/T2 in a focused associated group; human resolves currentness. Empty selection, missing surviving work or missing withdrawal context is critical.
